content:
Anna C: FYI private rollout to customer-vpc-3 didn't progress past 0%. control-plane shows 'applied' but agents report pending. anyone seen this pattern before?
Josh P: :eyes: seeing similar for air-gapped sites last week. what's the last agent heartbeat?
deploy-bot: rollout customer-vpc-3/2026-03-20T10:15 started -> canary 0% (intent:5%)
Riley M: agents are returning ack=delayed for the split-binding step. logs show long CPI (control-plane -> agent) queue.
Marta L: is this the case where the admin console waits for canary ack before opening traffic? we block at 0% until ack.
Anna C: yes, console waits. that's by design for strict canary guarantees, but in private/VPC we sometimes lose the ack due to NAT/airgap sync windows.
Josh P: thought we had a fallback: local config caching should allow a soft-start up to 1% after T=30s. looks like that didn't trigger.
Riley M: found a snippet in agent logs: `WARN reconciliation: cache-stale ttl=600s, controlplane-poll=failed, fallback_disabled=true`
Marta L: ugly. fallback_disabled is set when `airgap_mode=true` in rollout manifest to avoid partial exposure. customer requested airgap strictness.
Anna C: customer asked for strict canaries but we need an escape for control-plane propagation failures. idea: introduce a "deferred-ack" state where console can allow a tiny starter slice (0.5-1%) when agents are known healthy recently.
Josh P: Implementation idea: if last_agent_heartbeat < 5m && controlplane_pending>30s -> allow `deferred_ack` up to x% via local cache, but mark route as 'soft-canary' in the console with clear warning.
Riley M: prefer config rule: `deferred_ack_window: 120s` + `deferred_max_split: 1%`. Also surface telemetry: agent_heartbeat_ts, reconcile_attempts, last_successful_sync.
Marta L: console UX needs a red banner: "Partial traffic delivered from cached config due to control-plane sync delay" and a link to run a manual recon.
Anna C: we should be careful with SLA/contract language; log this action in audit trail and require an explicit tenant opt-in for auto-deferred ack.
Josh P: agree. opt-in flag `private_rollout.defer_on_sync_fail: true`. default false.
Riley M: quick diagnostic command for on-call: `/rb reconcile customer-vpc-3 --force` and `/rb status customer-vpc-3 --last-heartbeat`. add to runbook.
Marta L: adding telemetry fields to rollout index: `deferred_used`, `deferred_reason`, `deferred_percent`, `reconcile_forced_by`.
sre-bot: Incident created: #INF-7892 "customer-vpc-3 stuck at canary 0% - deferred-ack proposal"
Anna C: short term fix: enable `defer_on_sync_fail` for this customer after legal ok, bump deferred_max_split to 1% and run manual reconcile.
Josh P: I'll open a PR for the agent change to respect local cache delivery when `deferred_ack` is allowed. small change in reconciliation loop.
Riley M: I'll update console: show last agent heartbeat and a trigger button for forced reconcile. log button press to audit.
Marta L: I'll write a short blurb for CS explaining opt-in tradeoffs and default behavior.
Anna C: thanks team. let's track work in INF-7892 and link to RFC for deferred-ack behaviour (RFC-PRIV-34). follow-up in #eng-oncall if it fires again. :thumbsup:
